title: John Harbaugh provides Malik Nabers injury update: 'Impossible to predict'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh provides Malik Nabers injury update: 'Impossible to predict'
sources.description: John Harbaugh has a goal in mind for Malik Nabers' return from injury but noted it was "impossible to predict" if the WR would be able to meet it.
